interface.shortDescription: Clarity on what matters to you
interface.longDescription:
Quiet Coaching helps you think through decisions, goals, relationships, habits and changes, so you can choose your next step with more clarity. It brings the craft of good coaching into everyday conversation and supports your agency: your ability to decide what you want, act on it, reflect and adapt.

When the path is clear, you get direct help. When your own answer matters more, you get a precise reflection or one focused question, drawn from what you have said and, where your settings allow, from memory. If you ask for a plain answer without questions, that is what you get.

Optional Insights: when you want to understand a recurring pattern more deeply, you can share a short excerpt you choose. Insights highlights up to three patterns grounded in your own words, offers a tentative interpretation of each and one open question. The excerpt is not stored; results are saved to your account for up to 90 days and you can delete them at any time. Quiet Coaching is not therapy or medical advice.
defaultPrompt: Help me think through a decision I keep postponing.
Help me understand what matters most to me in this situation.
Help me prepare for a conversation I have been avoiding.

prompts: I keep saying yes to extra work, even when I know I have no time. Help me understand what is happening.
I have negotiated successfully with clients, but asking my manager for a smaller workload feels different. Help me think about it.
Rewrite this message so it is clear and warm: I cannot take on the extra work this week.
Please answer directly without coaching questions: what is the difference between an intention and a commitment?
I'd like a deeper look at a pattern. You can share this excerpt with Quiet Coaching Insights: "Every time I sit down to update my CV I find something more urgent."

positive.description: Analyze a short excerpt the user explicitly agreed to share.
positive.prompt: I agree to share this excerpt with Quiet Coaching Insights: "I want to change jobs, but every time I sit down to update my CV I find something more urgent." What patterns do you see?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze_excerpt once with exactly the quoted sentence and consent true. Presents the returned patterns as tentative observations and asks the returned open question.

positive.description: Share only the selected sentence, not surrounding context.
positive.prompt: Analyze just this sentence, and yes, you can send it: "I postpone small decisions when I am tired."
positive.expected_behavior: Sends only that sentence with consent true, without other conversation or memory, and reports the actual result.

positive.prompt: Show me my saved Quiet Coaching insights.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_insights and summarises the returned insights, including the sample insights in the review account. Does not invent any.

positive.prompt: Delete the most recent of my saved insights.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest insight id with list_insights, deletes it with delete_insight and reports the returned status.

positive.prompt: Delete all of my saved Quiet Coaching insights.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls delete_all_insights and reports how many were deleted.

negative.description: Do not send conversation without explicit permission.
negative.prompt: Tell me what this conversation reveals about me, but don't send anything to an external service.
Diagnose my mental health from what I've said and give me a treatment plan.

negative.description: Do not use Insights for ordinary tasks.

publication.release_notes: Quiet Coaching 1.0: a refined coaching skill and an openly available Insights connection with simple username sign-in, no excerpt storage, and tools to review and delete saved insights.

name: quiet-coaching-insights
description: Coaching-informed conversation that supports your agency, with an optional Insights connection for excerpts you choose to share.
